Regaber SKYplatform API · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST

Base URL: https://api.skyplatform.matwatertech.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
    "password": "********",
    "project_id": 285428
}
  • Get Token → performs POST /Token (form-urlencoded, grant_type=password) and stores bag["access_token"].
  • Subsequent requests must include the header: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
  • Token validity: 1 day (1 209 599 seconds). Not persisted; each execution requires a new login.

2) Element Tree

Project (Type 1)
└── ControlZone / Area (Type 2)
    └── SKYreg Concentrator (Type 200)
        └── SKYreg Hydrant (Type 221)
            └── SKYreg WaterMeter (Type 207)
SKYmeter NB-IoT (Type 3106)
└── SKYmeterNBIoT WaterMeter (Type 3107)

Use GET /TreeNode to discover the full tree and obtain element IDs.

3) Counter Endpoints

Device TypeEndpoint
SKYreg WaterMeterGET /SKYreg/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}
SKYreg Hydrant (water meter)GET /SKYreg/Hydrant/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}
SKYmeter NB-IoT WaterMeterGET /SKYmeterNBIoT/WaterMeter/LastValue/?id={id}

4) Response Format

SKYreg / SKYreg Hydrant:

{
  "TreeNodeId": 178089,
  "Type": 12,
  "Units": "m³",
  "LastValue": {
    "Value": 66404.0,
    "DateTime": "01/01/2024 08:00"
  }
}

SKYmeter NB-IoT:

{
  "TreeNodeId": 934067,
  "Units": "m³",
  "LastValue": {
    "Value": 288.0,
    "DateTime": "01/01/2024 08:00"
  }
}

DateTime format: dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm (European format).

5) Odoo Configuration (via wua_remotecontrol_rest_regaber)

In each wua.waterconnection:

  • Regaber TreeNode ID: Integer ID from GET /TreeNode.
  • Regaber Device Type: skyreg, skyreg_hydrant, or skymeter_nbiot.
  • project_id in connection_params is optional but recommended. If set, discovery/import is limited to that project.

6) Available Procedures

  • Regaber: Get Tree Nodes — Downloads the full element tree and creates a JSON attachment.
  • Regaber: Get Last Readings — Used internally by the WUA module to fetch the last counter value for each configured waterconnection.

# SKYplatform uses Bearer token authentication. # POST /Token with application/x-www-form-urlencoded, grant_type=password. remote = self.remote_id cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {} username = (cfg.get('username') or '').strip() password = (cfg.get('password') or '').strip() if not username or not password: raise Exception( "Missing Regaber credentials: set username/password " "in connection_params.") url = (base_url or '').rstrip('/') + '/Token' token_data = { 'username': username, 'password': password, 'grant_type': 'password', } resp = request_retry( 'POST', url, data=token_data, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, timeout=timeout, ) if resp.status_code >= 400: raise Exception( "Regaber token request failed: %s %s" % ( resp.status_code, resp.text)) try: j = resp.json() except Exception as e: raise Exception("Failed to parse Regaber token response: %s" % str(e)) access_token = j.get('access_token') or '' if not access_token: raise Exception( "Regaber login OK but no access_token in response: %s" % str(j)) bag['access_token'] = access_token bag['token_type'] = j.get('token_type', 'bearer') bag['expires_in'] = j.get('expires_in') bag['token_username'] = j.get('userName', '')
